"""Independently exercise the candidate against verified but different complete payments."""
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("size_measure",Path("experiments/payment-size/measure.py"))
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
bin_dir,run_dir=map(Path,sys.argv[1:3])
binary=(bin_dir/"cp03-public-fixed-transport").resolve()
info=m.common.read_json(run_dir/"RESULT.json")
assert info["candidate_binary_sha256"] == m.digest(binary) and info["passed"]
inst=m.common.load_installation(Path(".work/sizerev01/fresh/installation.json"),info["installation_sha256"])
def run(kind, files, args, err):
    argv=['/usr/bin/bwrap','--unshare-all','--new-session','--die-with-parent','--cap-drop','ALL',
          '--clearenv','--setenv','LANG','C','--proc','/proc','--dev','/dev','--dir','/inputs',
          '--ro-bind',str(binary),'/program']
    for p in m.closure(binary):
        assert inst['pins'][str(p.resolve())] == m.digest(p)
        argv += ['--ro-bind',str(p.resolve()),str(p)]
    files_in={}
    for name,path in files.items():
        argv += ['--ro-bind',str(path.resolve()),'/inputs/'+name]
        files_in[name] = m.digest(path)
    argv += ['--remount-ro','/','--chdir','/','--','/program',*args]
    proc,out,errors = m.common.run(argv,cwd=Path.cwd(),seconds=60,cap=256*1024)
    assert proc['wrapper_exit'] == 0 and not proc['timeout'], proc
    if err:
        assert proc['process_exit'] == 1 and not out and errors == (err+'\n').encode()
        return dict(case=kind,inputs=files_in,outcome=err,exit=1)
    result=json.loads(out)
    assert proc['process_exit'] == 0 and not errors and result['final_positive_reverified']
    return dict(case=kind,inputs=files_in,outcome=result,exit=0)
out=[]
source=Path(inst['source_root'])
for i,row in enumerate(info['rows']):
    assert row['public_verify']['expected_statement_checked'] and row['expected_instance_bytes'] == 528
    other=info['rows'][(i+1)%len(info['rows'])]
    wrong=source/'experiments/compact-all-payments-v3/public'/('cp03-cycle-'+other['label']+'-payer')/'statement.bin'
    assert m.digest(wrong) == other['statement_sha256'] and m.digest(wrong) != row['statement_sha256']
    out.append(run(row['label']+' against '+other['label'],dict(body=run_dir/f'sample{i+1}.body',expected=wrong),
                   ['verify-against','/inputs/body','/inputs/expected'],'ExpectedStatement'))
full=source/'experiments/cp03-private-cycle/evidence/psizerev01.public/payer2x2.body'
out.append(run('candidate and reference controls',dict(full=full),['controls','/inputs/full'],None))
print(json.dumps(dict(binary_sha256=m.digest(binary),rows=out),indent=2))
